text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, acetaminophen supply is constrained across Corvale sites. Corvale East holds 25 days on hand, Corvale General holds 24 days, and Corvale Lakeside holds 12 days. Specific product days on hand range from 8.8 days for acetaminophen injection at Lakeside to 31.6 days for oxycodone/acetaminophen tablets at East.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows Endo Pharmaceuticals' acetaminophen/oxycodone tablet was posted as To Be Discontinued on 2025-11-03. A Baxter Healthcare recall for acetaminophen injection due to discoloration was initiated on 2025-08-20 and remains ongoing.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs but Lakeside injection supply is critical. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no identifiable plant. No clinical changes are proposed; those decisions rest with clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with B. Braun Medical Inc., Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc., Caplin Steriles Limited, Civica Inc., and Eugia US LLC for acetaminophen injection and combination tablets; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to prioritize Lakeside acetaminophen injection replenishment; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes on listed manufacturers and Baxter recall; requires Pharmacy Manager approval.
4. Inventory team to conduct weekly cycle counts at all three sites; requires Operations Manager approval.

Not recommended: Switching patients to alternative analgesics or changing formularies without P&T clinical review. Allocating stock between sites without a formal redistribution policy approved by the committee.
